blocks.html: Whether you are going on a retreat or going out of town for the Holy Week, it’s good to know that Robinsons Malls still got you covered with your needs- be it from grocery shopping, to dining out, or getting a quick retail fix. The following Robinsons Malls are open on regular mall hours on April 13, Maundy Thursday and April 14, Good Friday: Robinsons Place Antipolo, Robinsons Luisita and Summit Ridge Promenade in Tagaytay. Robinsons Place Gen. Trias, Robinsons Place Malolos, Robinsons Place Palawan, Robinsons Place Pangasinan, Robinsons Place Santiago and Robinsons Starmills Pampanga will be only open on Maundy Thursday while Robinsons Place Ilocos will only open on Good Friday. Apart from these branches, all other Robinsons Malls shall be closed on Maundy Thursday and Good Friday. All regular mall schedules will resume on April 15, Black Saturday, following regular Mall Hours.
